summary: Create a pink-and-gold business website for Tech Collective LLC advertising services: notarial, simple phone configuration/setup, website creation, and tech consultations.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Minimalist tech-inspired logo in pink and gold on transparent background (tech-collective-logo.dim_512x512.png)
- Abstract gradient hero background with subtle circuitry pattern in pink and gold (hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png)
- Set of 4 small line-style service icons in pink/gold: notary, phone setup, website creation, tech consultation (service-icons-sprite.dim_512x128.png)

existing_features.title: Create a responsive marketing website for “Tech Collective LLC” with clear navigation and sections for: Hero/intro, Services, About, and Contact.
Add a Services section that lists and describes the currently offered services: Notarial services; Simple phone configuration & setup; Website creation; Tech consultations.
Apply a consistent pink-and-gold visual theme across the site (colors, typography, buttons, section styling), ensuring sufficient contrast and accessibility.
Add a Contact section with a simple inquiry form (name, email/phone, service interested in, message) and a clear confirmation state after submission.
Persist submitted contact inquiries in the Motoko backend and expose query methods to retrieve them for display in a simple internal “Inquiries” view/page (no external email integration).

Generate and add static brand imagery (logo and a hero background/illustration) in a cohesive pink-and-gold style, and render them in the site header/hero from frontend static assets (not via backend).
